packageRules.description: Keep generated dependency evidence outside update ownership
Keep both setuptools build declarations aligned
Require the complete Python dependency contract review
prBodyNotes: Keep pyproject.toml, .python-version, uv.lock, the frozen installed graph, and dependency evidence aligned. Run the complete non-live quality suite and review any compatibility-bound change before merge.

packageRules.description: Keep Python runtime updates within the declared requires-python minor line; minor-line changes are intentional runtime migrations, not routine updates
Keep Playwright package and derived browser metadata coupled
prBodyNotes: The Playwright Python package owns its browser revision. Regenerate and review the derived browser metadata; do not add or update an independent browser pin.

packageRules.description: Require workflow and graph review for GitHub Actions
prBodyNotes: Review the action release notes for runtime and input changes, then run actionlint plus the complete non-live quality suite.
